news.title: Chatha Foods Limited Announces Change in Designation of Mrs. Rachna Singh Chaudhary as Chief Human Resource Officer, Effective March 11, 2026
news.body: Chatha Foods Limited announced that the Board of Directors at their meeting held on March 11, 2026, approved the change in designation of Mrs. Rachna Singh Chaudhary, as Chief Human Resource Officer and designated as Senior Management Personnel of the Company, with effect from March 11, 2026. Ms. Rachna Singh Chaudhary is a seasoned Human Resources leader with over two decades of extensive experience in strategic HR leadership, organizational development, industrial relations, and corporate HR operations across diverse industries including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and engineering. news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 2 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 2 independent directors. 3 non-independent directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Purnachand Upadrashta was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2023. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.2% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk High level of non-cash earnings (55% accrual ratio). news.title: First half 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.33 (vs ₹1.44 in 1H 2025)
news.body: First half 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.33 (down from ₹1.44 in 1H 2025). Revenue: ₹843.8m (up 13% from 1H 2025). Net income: ₹29.3m (down 9.5% from 1H 2025). Profit margin: 3.5% (down from 4.3% in 1H 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses.
